defaultPrompt: I am stuck starting a task. Help me find a manageable first action.
Help me sort this brain dump and choose what to do first.
Help me pick up interrupted work using this checkpoint.
interface.longDescription:
Bring a task you cannot start, a brain dump, or a checkpoint from interrupted work. ADHD Task Helper helps you choose a practical next action and keeps the response easy to follow.

- Adapt replies to your preferred level of detail.
- Get a manageable starting action and practical help.
- Sort a brain dump while preserving deferred items.
- Resume from available conversation context or a checkpoint you provide.

How it works:
1. Share what you are trying to do or where you got stuck.
2. Receive a starting action, an organized list, or a restart note.
3. Continue, ask for more detail, or request one step at a time.

name: adhd-task-helper
description: ADHD-friendly support for clearer replies, starting a task, sorting a brain dump, and resuming interrupted work.
